meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 收到文档链接、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频等来源时，Claude 会先自动识别来源类型，再用 Skill Seekers 的 40 个工具抓取、转换，并可增强、打包、导出成 AI 技能。
howto.when: 当用户想从文档、GitHub、PDF、视频等来源创建 AI 技能，或要更新同步已有技能、导出到向量数据库时触发。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 转换成 AI 技能
say.note: 将识别 PDF 并抓取内容生成技能。

say.text: 从 GitHub 仓库 foo/bar 做一个技能
say.note: 会抓取仓库并按流程构建技能。

say.text: 把刚才的技能导出到 Weaviate
say.note: 调用向量库导出工具完成写入。

howto.what_en: When given a documentation link, GitHub repo, PDF, video, or other source, Claude detects the source type and uses Skill Seekers' 40 tools to scrape and convert it, then can enhance, package, or export it as an AI skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to create an AI skill from docs, GitHub, PDFs, videos, or other sources, update/sync an existing skill, or export skills to vector databases.

say_en.text: Turn this PDF into an AI skill.
say_en.note: Detects the PDF and generates a skill from it.

say_en.text: Build a skill from the repo foo/bar.
say_en.note: Scrapes the repository and builds the skill.
Writes it via the vector DB export tool.
